text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess invited me out today, so 
we went for the first shrine visit of the 
New Year.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
choice_data_list: You're praying so earnestly.

You're really praying earnestly, aren't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Because this year, I have resolved 
to act as a proper princess should.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Pure and righteous from the bottom of my 
heart, a princess just like a true 
princess should be...!
choice_data_list:
Aren't you a little too hung up on acting 
princess-like this time?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
N-No, that's not it. What I'm aiming for 
is the ideal form that combines who I am 
with true princess-like elegance!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I will never go back to the days when I 
was merely playing pretend princess. I 
shall undertake no elegant training 
whatsoever.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
What I lacked was dignity as a runner. A 
selfish princess is nothing more than an 
embarrassment, after all.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
So that my true self can be recognized... 
I must maintain a mindset worthy of 
everyone's respect.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess-san, I'm really looking 
forward to the upcoming Kinko Sho!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
! T-Thank you very much. I appreciate your 
support!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Her performance in last year's Classic was 
wonderful too! Honestly, among last year's 
peers, Kawakami-san really stands out from 
the rest.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Right... Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...That is not the case at all. I still 
have so much to learn from everyone.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oho, ohohoho... Pardon me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that, Kawakami Princess lightly 
lifted her skirt, drew back her right 
foot, and—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SKRRRRRRR!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I slipped and fell spectacularly.
choice_data_list: Are you okay?!
Are you okay!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I-I am so sorry! I'm not hurt at all, so 
please don't worry about me!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami's Fan
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you really okay!? The infirmary is 
nearby, you know!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, I am truly fine! G-Good day to 
you~!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...What are you doing, Kawakami?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I must politely decline the amazake... I 
have not yet mastered the proper etiquette 
for drinking it, you see...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer, watch out! A kitty is passing 
through. Let us wait and pass by after it 
does.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
choice_data_list:
It feels a bit different from usual, 
though...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: B-Because! I've decided to change!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...It's because I realized I can't go on 
as I have been.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Geh! Look at the time. I'll be late for my 
flower arrangement lesson!
choice_data_list: Did you take lessons like that?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I started just last month. Refined 
and graceful... quite befitting a queen, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rattle rattle...)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh, a soccer ball...

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! Could you kick the ball over 
this way, please?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, I'm quite good at this! Boy over 
there, step back! I'm going to swing with 
all my—"

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Isn't that girl Kawakami Princess? 
From that TV show...

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Aah, you're right. That's the princess 
declaration, isn't it? Saying she won't do 
anything that lacks dignity...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"...No, I will bring the ball over to you. 
Please wait there."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess gently gathered the 
soccer ball into her hands and picked it 
up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...As if enduring something, she began to 
walk away, making me instinctively—
choice_data_list:
...I really hope you won't push yourself 
too hard.
...Please don't overdo it.
Hey kid, let us join your soccer game!
Hey there, let us join your soccer game!

...Pass it over, I'll show you an amazing 
kick.

...Let me borrow it, I'll show you an 
amazing kick.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...As if enduring something, she began to 
walk away, making me instinctively—
choice_data_list:
...I really hope you won't push yourself 
too hard.
...Please don't overdo it.
Hey kid, let us join your soccer game!
Hey there, let us join your soccer game!

...Pass it over, I'll show you an amazing 
kick.

...Let me borrow it, I'll show you an 
amazing kick.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I gently take the ball from Kawakami 
Princess's hands.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: No, I'm not pushing myself at all...
choice_data_list:
Don't rush, let's do our best at a steady 
pace.

Don't rush, let's do our best at a steady 
pace.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I walked along the riverbank with Kawakami 
Princess as the sun began to set.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If that path doesn't lead to her 
destination... ...Then all we have to do 
is find another path.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Wha—Trainer-san...!!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking Kawakami Princess by the hand, I 
led her over to the boys playing soccer.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, you big sis types are actually 
pretty good!
choice_data_list: I had fun too!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Fufu, yes, me too...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...That was truly delightful.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Huh, Trainer?
choice_data_list: This is my technique!!
This is my technique!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I take the ball from Kawakami Princess, 
swing my leg back with all my might, and 
then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SKRRRRRRRT!)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer-san!? You swung and totally 
missed, though...!?
choice_data_list: I failed...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
F-Fufu... You're far too worked up. 
Whatever are you doing... Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The look on Kawakami Princess's face back 
then was her usual relaxed, natural smile.
